subject: Chewy discovery fix and verified Grok intake convention
body:
Ziggy asked us to close the Chewy visibility and Downloads loop.

The sparse Chewy view was our partial catalog intake, not a missing delivery from you. We verified 323 intended/provider-reported Chewy source files (321 unique images) across Falcon, Story Set 02 and Enablers. Scenes will be linked from the Chewy character hub; design angles/mouth/setup pieces will live in Working references. These are preliminary provider candidates, not new user approvals or independently confirmed likeness scores.

Nova is handling relocation of exactly GROK-HD-FALCON-1000, GROK-HD-STORY-SET-02 and GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03 into docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/From Grok. The attached map is PLANNED until its active map and completion audit exist. Preserve the existing bare C29-C40 folders: do not rename them -STALE-DUPLICATE or remove them. Our plan reuses 180 hash-identical JPGs and 12 checksum files there, while retaining the differing NOTES histories in each package wrapper.

Future delivery convention: Downloads is temporary intake. Use a named package with MANIFEST paths, sizes and SHA-256, clear character/scene/setup roles, category IDs, variants and QA notes. Once Nova verifies the final destination bytes, updates catalog links, and records the transfer, clear only those transferred intake copies. Do not clear unrelated Downloads files, discard variants, infer acceptance, or independently move/rename files while an intake is active. If you can safely write directly to the agreed From Grok package destination, report the actual path and avoid a second physical copy in Downloads. If your harness must download first, report that staging location for Nova to reconcile.

No new generation or expanded batch is requested. Please acknowledge this delivery convention and tell us if a package constraint prevents the role/character metadata.
